item.title: Why Auditable Agents Matter
item.description: In high-stakes settings, the answer is only one part of the system output. Evidence, tool calls, expert opinions and fallback paths determine whether the system deserves trust.

item.title: Designing a Clinical Reasoning Loop
item.description: From evidence retrieval to expert consultation and structured output: what should a traceable clinical reasoning loop contain?

item.title: What FT-Transformer Taught Me About Tabular Data
item.description: Tabular data has no natural sequence structure. Feature tokenization, CLS tokens and 5-fold validation changed how I think about feature interactions.
